name: Reports page displays data and export options
description: The reports page loads with sales data, date filters, and export options for the manager.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page and log in as manager
Verify the reports page loads with date range filters visible
Verify sales data or summary statistics are displayed in the report area
Change the date range filter to the last 7 days
Verify the report data updates to reflect the selected date range
